def evaluate(label, phrase):
    adjs, noun = adjectives(phrase)
    cats = [CAT_OF[a] for a in adjs]
    tie = any(cats[i] == cats[i + 1] for i in range(len(cats) - 1))
    ordered = all(RANK[cats[i]] < RANK[cats[i + 1]] for i in range(len(cats) - 1))
    unwitnessed = [(cats[i], cats[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cats) - 1)
                   if (cats[i], cats[i + 1]) not in pairs]
    if tie:
        verdict = "UNSUPPORTED"
    elif ordered:
        verdict = "ORDER OK"
    else:
        verdict = "ORDER WRONG"
    print(f"({label}) adjectives={adjs} categories={cats} noun={' '.join(noun)}")
    print(f"    verdict={verdict} unwitnessed_adjacent_pairs={unwitnessed}")
    return verdict
